description: Strict Dual-Handle Asset Registry for AI Video Editor (Conductor + Flash Editor)

@asset.description: Global reusable studio library (videos, photos, reels, backgrounds, memes, logos, mockups, fonts, SFX, music).

subfolders.@asset/video/backgrounds: assets/video/backgrounds/ (Loopable studio, abstract, & green-screen replacement plates)
subfolders.@asset/video/broll: assets/video/broll/ (Cinematic B-roll clips & Veo 3.1 reusable library)
subfolders.@asset/video/overlays: assets/video/overlays/ (ProRes 4444 confetti, film grain, light leaks, glass shards)
subfolders.@asset/photo/textures: assets/photo/textures/ (Torn cream paper #F0EADE, notebook grid, halftone, newspaper clippings)
subfolders.@asset/mockups/ui: assets/mockups/ui/ (NLE timeline, Lightroom inspector, IG Reel frame chrome)
subfolders.@asset/audio/sfx: assets/audio/sfx/ (48kHz studio foley: pop.wav, whoosh.wav, click.wav, sub_drop.wav, paper_thock.wav, paper_slide.wav, marker_squeak.wav, timeline_tick.wav)
subfolders.@asset/fonts: assets/fonts/ (Local display, serif, and monospace font files)

@project.description: Per-project scoped handle for clip-specific recordings, Apple Vision ProRes 4444 cutouts, and rendered overlays.

subfolders.@project/broll: broll/<Project>/ (Project-specific screenshots, Flow AI generations, & HyperFrames .mov/.webm overlays)
subfolders.@project/transcript: transcripts/<Project>/ (10ms RMS acoustic onset JSON & SRT)
